narrative_purpose: The chapter's representative plate for the landing book-map: the whole idea in one image - a branching tree of Pandoran life reconstructed from bodies alone, its root quietly dissolving into a web.
subject: A luminous branching tree drawn as a phylogenetic diagram, its tips ending in faint glowing silhouettes of distinct Pandoran creatures - a six-legged running beast, a winged flyer, a finned swimmer, and one upright four-limbed humanoid set among them; the branches are clean glowing lines forking from inner nodes; toward the base the single trunk frays into several crossing strands, a clean tree becoming a faint reticulate web at the root.
scene: A dark naturalist's reconstruction space, the tree floating as if drawn in light, deep haze beyond.
camera: A clean front-on view, the tree filling the frame, root at lower-left fraying, tips fanning to the right.
light: Bioluminescent key glowing from within the branch-lines, cyan and living-teal; the lone humanoid tip lit a touch warmer; the frayed web at the root dimmer and cooler; deep indigo shadow throughout.
palette: Void-indigo ground, cyan and living-teal glow in the branches, one scarce amber accent on the humanoid tip, restrained.
style: Painterly naturalist specimen plate, hand-painted texture, confident focal hierarchy.
detail_level: Crisp on the branching structure and the creature tips; the reticulate root softer; edges dissolving into haze.
composition: A left-to-right branching tree across the frame, generous dark negative space, the root fraying into a web at lower-left, the humanoid tip placed quietly among the others.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette, bioluminescent key from within the drawn lines. Same dark glowing-specimen mood as the established chapter covers.
